rationale: The plan uses the correct DESeq2 Wald model ~ sex + age + condition with control as explicit reference, apeglm on the condition coefficient, BH at 0.05, median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, and a minimal justified filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples). It falls short of the reference by not centering age, by deferring the sex/age-by-group balance tabulation to the final report rather than checking confounding before fitting, and by omitting the XIST/Y-linked sex check; the outlier policy is only 'flag'. Enrichment was not requested and is added as unasked scope, though when included it is specified reasonably (Wald-stat ranking, tested-gene universe, 15-500 window, versions recorded in the report). The report step is thorough, covering design, thresholds, NA accounting by cause, versions, and the unmatched-age caveat.
